annotations.title: Approve, reject, retry or cancel a reshare / comment

description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] approve lets a rule's reshare / comment go out at its time; retry re-sends a failed one (same idempotency key); reject / cancel stop it. Confirm with the user before approving. Needs the `publish` scope (or admin) on the Agency plan or higher.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/automations/actions/{id}.)
name: act_on_publish_action
title: Approve, reject, retry or cancel a reshare / comment
